title: "James Q. Reber" – portrait of Ad Hoc Requirements Committee chairman (p. 81)
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a man in suit and tie, captioned "James Q. Reber." The adjacent text explains that Richard Bissell named Reber Intelligence Requirements Officer for the U-2 project and chairman of the Ad Hoc Requirements Committee (ARC), established 1 December 1955.
